selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq (KAPA stranded RiboErase, HiSeq 3000 50bp SE), prostate tumor tissue of male TRAMP mice (S4.6.p1)
selected.sample_inclusion: 18 male TRAMP mice randomized 1:1:1 to control, exercise (voluntary wheel running, singly housed), Phellodendron amurense extract diet (S4.2.p1); 12-week intervention; tumors from 3 representative animals per group sequenced (S2.2.p1, S4.6.p1)
selected.primary_estimand: Effect of 12 weeks of voluntary wheel running vs no intervention on prostate tumor gene expression in TRAMP mice (S2.2.p1)
planned_contrasts: Phellodendron amurense extract vs control (S2.2.p2; paper: 176 DEGs, 100 down / 76 up)
selected.repeated_measure_unit: none; one tumor per animal, independent animals

selected.paper_method: R package DESeq (original), group-pairwise comparisons on HTSeq counts; TopHat to UCSC genome (S4.7.p1)

paper_threshold.extra_filter: at least one group average RPKM > 1

paper_results.pham_vs_control: 176 DEGs (100 down, 76 up); down Spink3, Spink5, Slc26a4, Slc45a3, Slc5a8, Apof, Pls1, Mmp7, Dclk3, Gstt3, Atp2c2; up Dcx, Sncb (S2.2.p2, S3.p2)

selected.analysis_type: multi-group, one model, pairwise contrasts against control

decisions.reason: Three independent arms with one control (S4.2.p1); paper reports each intervention vs control (S2.2.p1, S2.2.p2). One model with planned contrasts; any other listed comparison is exploratory.

Independent animals, one tumor each; no batch, lane or pairing recorded in GEO or paper. Housing (single for EX, group for CON/PHAM, S4.2.p1/S4.3.p1) is part of the intervention and fully aliased with arm, so it cannot and should not be modelled.

selected.method: DESeq2 (pydeseq2 Wald), one model ~ grp, contrasts vs CON

paper_route.method: DESeq (original Bioconductor DESeq, negative-binomial exact test, group-pairwise)
paper_route.reason: no original-DESeq executor in this repository; DESeq2 is the validated successor on the same count input

deviations: DESeq2 Wald test instead of original DESeq exact test

paper's 'average RPKM > 1 in at least one group' filter not applied: no gene lengths in the deposit (gene-symbol HTSeq counts, mm9); DESeq2 independent filtering used instead; a CPM>=1 in >=3 samples low-count filter is run as a sensitivity analysis

decisions.reason: Raw integer counts support the negative-binomial route; reproduce the paper's NB count model with DESeq2 as a declared deviation.

selected.deviation_note: Paper rule FDR<0.05 and FC>1.5 either way (|log2FC|>log2(1.5)=0.5849625) applied on DESeq2; the RPKM>1 expression prefilter cannot be applied (no gene lengths).

decisions.reason: S4.7.p1: FDR adjusted p < 0.05 and fold change > 1.5 (either way); ABS.p1 says >= 1.5-fold, S4.7.p1 (methods) says > 1.5, methods wording used.
One DESeq2 model ~ grp on all 9 samples; planned EX vs CON (primary) and PHAM vs CON (secondary); any other listed comparison exploratory.
Stand-in for the paper's RPKM>1 expression prefilter: keep genes with CPM>=1 in >=3 samples (one group's worth).

Two-arm DESeq2 on the 6 CON+EX samples only, so dispersion and Cook flags are not driven by the heterogeneous PHAM arm; paper says group-pairwise without stating whether dispersion was pooled across all groups.

decisions.reason: sensitivity: the two-arm fit recovers the paper named exercise genes; check whether its DEGs reproduce the paper triglyceride/lipase GO terms (Fig. 3)

caveats: n = 3 tumors per arm, chosen as 'representative' by the authors (S2.2.p1); small study
exercise arm singly housed while control group housed: housing is aliased with exercise
original DESeq and RPKM>1 prefilter not reproduced; DEG counts are expected to differ

Direction contradiction: paper says BB123696 and Lman1l increased with exercise and with PhAm (S2.2.p3); here both are lower in EX (log2FC -1.58, -1.83, not significant) and significantly lower in PHAM (log2FC -4.32, -5.33).

Paper exercise DEGs Lipe, Plin1, Slc7a10 agree in direction (down in EX, log2FC -1.5 to -2.4) but get padj NA in the joint model (Cook outlier flag driven by the heterogeneous PHAM arm); Dgat2l6 up (log2FC 5.8) but not significant.

Two of three PHAM tumors (GSM8878842, GSM8878843) are transcriptionally distinct from all other samples (Spearman ~0.6-0.7 vs >=0.93), with high Dcx/Sncb and loss of Spink3/Plin1 -- consistent with a different tumor phenotype; PHAM vs CON gives thousands of DEGs instead of the paper 176.

Exercise DEG set overlaps the paper only in count (32 vs 32); most of our EX DEGs are up (27/32) and include seminal-vesicle secretory genes (Svs1-6, Sva, Spinkl), suggesting differing seminal-vesicle tissue content in the excised tumors.

The two-arm CON+EX sensitivity fit recovers all five paper exercise genes in the paper direction (Lipe, Plin1, Slc7a10, Gpr83 down; Dgat2l6 up; padj<0.05) but calls 385 DEGs; the joint fit matches the paper count (32) but not its genes. The paper likely fitted each pair separately with the more conservative original DESeq plus an RPKM filter.

decisions.reason: Counts from S2.2.p1 / S2.2.p2; genes from S2.2.p1-p3, S3.p1, S3.p2. Expected directions: EX down Lipe, Plin1, Slc7a10, Gpr83; EX up Dgat2l6, BB123696, Lman1l; PHAM down Spink3..Atp2c2, up Dcx, Sncb, BB123696, Lman1l.
